pages.title: Maid Matches
pages.text: Maids can participate in Gomoku, Chinese Chess, and Western Chess. Players and maids can occupy either side of a match, and two maids can also play against one another.

pages.title: Nearby Spectators
pages.text: Other nearby maids may sit down to watch and occasionally comment on the match. When the game ends or is interrupted, they return to their normal activities.
